How AI Agents Remember

An agent’s memory, part by part: episodic memory (past conversations), semantic memory (knowledge bases and grounding context, stored as vectors), procedural memory (prompts and tools) and the short-term working memory the orchestrator builds for each step. Press a numbered flow to watch it run, or tap any box.

Tap a box

Each box explains one part of agent memory. Coloured arrows move continuously; the numbered buttons run one flow at a time.

The flows and labels follow the original figure; the explanations are ours. Products and tools named in the panels are examples, not endorsements. Disclosure: Claude, made by Anthropic, helps write this site.
